hebrews.8.p1.b1.text: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest,

hebrews.8.p1.b2.text: … who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

hebrews.8.p1.b3.text: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle …

hebrews.8.p1.b4.text: … set up by the Lord, not by man.

hebrews.8.p2.b5.text: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.

hebrews.8.p2.b6.text: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven.

hebrews.8.p2.b7.text: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”

hebrews.8.p2.b8.text: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better …

hebrews.8.p3.b9.text: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.

hebrews.8.p3.b10.text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

hebrews.8.p3.b11.text: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt …

hebrews.8.p3.b12.text: I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.

hebrews.8.p4.b13.text: … because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.

hebrews.8.p4.b14.text: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”

hebrews.8.p4.b15.text: By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete;

hebrews.8.p4.b16.text: and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.
